healthstate_name_pretty: Infectious disease, acute episode, mild
lay_description: has a low fever and mild discomfort , but no difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Infectious disease, acute episode, moderate
lay_description: has a fever and aches, and feels weak, which causes some difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Infectious disease, acute episode, severe
lay_description: has a high fever and pain, and feels very weak, which causes great difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Infectious disease, post-acute consequences (fatigue, emotional lability, insomnia)
lay_description: is always tired and easily upset. The person feels pain all over the body and is depressed.

healthstate_name_pretty: Diarrhea, mild
lay_description: has diarrhea three or more times a day with occasional discomfort in the belly.

healthstate_name_pretty: Diarrhea, moderate
lay_description: has diarrhea three or more times a day, with painful cramps in the belly and feeling thirsty

healthstate_name_pretty: Diarrhea, severe
lay_description: has diarrhea three or more times a day with severe belly cramps. The person is very thirsty and feels nauseous and tired.

healthstate_name_pretty: Epididymo-orchitis
lay_description: has swelling and tenderness in the testicles and pain during urination.

healthstate_name_pretty: Herpes zoster
lay_description: has a blistering skin rash that causes pain, with some burning and itching.

healthstate_name_pretty: HIV cases, symptomatic, pre-AIDS
lay_description: has weight loss, fatigue, and frequent infections.

healthstate_name_pretty: HIV/AIDS cases, receiving ARV treatment
lay_description: has occasional fevers and infections. The person takes daily medication that sometimes causes diarrhea.

healthstate_name_pretty: AIDS cases, not receiving ARV treatment
lay_description: has severe weight loss, weakness, fatigue, cough and fever, and frequent infections, skin rashes and diarrhea.

healthstate_name_pretty: Intestinal nematode infections, symptomatic
lay_description: has cramping pain and a bloated feeling in the belly.

healthstate_name_pretty: Lymphatic filariasis, symptomatic
lay_description: has swollen legs with hard and thick skin, which causes difficulty in moving around.

healthstate_name_pretty: Ear pain
lay_description: has an ear-ache that causes some difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Tuberculosis, not HIV infected
lay_description: has a persistent cough and fever, is short of breath, feels weak, and has lost a lot of weight.

healthstate_name_pretty: Tuberculosis, HIV infected
lay_description: has a persistent cough and fever, shortness of breath, night sweats, weakness and fatigue and severe weight loss.

healthstate_name_pretty: Cancer, diagnosis and primary therapy
lay_description: has pain, nausea, fatigue, weight loss and high anxiety.

healthstate_name_pretty: Cancer, metastatic
lay_description: has severe pain, extreme fatigue, weight loss and high anxiety.

healthstate_name_pretty: Mastectomy
lay_description: had one of her breasts removed and sometimes has pain or swelling in the arms.

healthstate_name_pretty: Stoma
lay_description: has a pouch attached to an opening in the belly to collect and empty stools.

healthstate_name_pretty: Terminal phase, with medication (for cancers, end-stage kidney/liver disease)
lay_description: has lost a lot of weight and regularly uses strong medication to avoid constant pain. The person has no appetite, feels nauseous, and needs to spend most of the day in bed.

healthstate_name_pretty: Terminal phase, without medication (for cancers, end-stage kidney/liver disease)
lay_description: has lost a lot of weight and has constant pain. The person has no appetite, feels nauseous, and needs to spend most of the day in bed.

healthstate_name_pretty: Acute myocardial infarction, days 1-2
lay_description: has severe chest pain that becomes worse with any physical activity,. The person feels nauseous, short of breath, and very anxious.

healthstate_name_pretty: Acute myocardial infarction, days 3-28
lay_description: gets short of breath after heavy physical activity, and tires easily, but has no problems when at rest. The person has to take medication every day and has some anxiety.

healthstate_name_pretty: Angina pectoris, mild
lay_description: has chest pain that occurs with strenuous physical activity, such as running or lifting heavy objects. After a brief rest, the pain goes away.

healthstate_name_pretty: Angina pectoris, moderate
lay_description: has chest pain that occurs with moderate physical activity, such as walking uphill or more than half a kilometer (around a quarter-mile) on level ground. After a brief rest, the pain goes away.

healthstate_name_pretty: Angina pectoris, severe
lay_description: has chest pain that occurs with minimal physical activity, such as walking only a short distance. After a brief rest, the pain goes away. The person avoids most physical activities because of the pain.

healthstate_name_pretty: Cardiac conduction disorders and cardiac dysrhythmias
lay_description: has periods of rapid and irregular heartbeats and occasional fainting.

healthstate_name_pretty: Claudication
lay_description: has cramping pains in the legs after walking a medium distance. The pain goes away after a short rest.

healthstate_name_pretty: Heart failure, mild
lay_description: is short of breath and easily tires with moderate physical activity, such as walking uphill or more than a quarter-mile on level ground. The person feels comfortable at rest or during activities requiring less effort.

healthstate_name_pretty: Heart failure, moderate
lay_description: is short of breath and easily tires with minimal physical activity, such as walking only a short distance. The person feels comfortable at rest but avoids moderate activity.

healthstate_name_pretty: Heart failure, severe
lay_description: is short of breath and feels tired when at rest. The person avoids any physical activity, for fear of worsening the breathing problems.

healthstate_name_pretty: Stroke, long-term consequences, mild
lay_description: has some difficulty in moving around and some weakness in one hand, but is able to walk without help.

healthstate_name_pretty: Stroke, long-term consequences, moderate
lay_description: has some difficulty in moving around, and in using the hands for lifting and holding things, dressing and grooming.

healthstate_name_pretty: Stroke, long-term consequences, moderate plus cognition problems
lay_description: has some difficulty in moving around, in using the hands for lifting and holding things, dressing and grooming, and in speaking. The person is often forgetful and confused.

healthstate_name_pretty: Stroke, long-term consequences, severe
lay_description: is confined to bed or a wheelchair, has difficulty speaking and depends on others for feeding, toileting and dressing.

healthstate_name_pretty: Stroke, long-term consequences, severe plus cognition problems
lay_description: is confined to bed or a wheelchair, depends on others for feeding, toileting and dressing, and has difficulty speaking, thinking clearly and remembering things.

healthstate_name_pretty: Diabetic neuropathy
lay_description: has pain, tingling and numbness in the arms, legs, hands and feet. The person sometimes gets cramps and muscle weakness.

healthstate_name_pretty: Chronic kidney disease (stage IV)
lay_description: tires easily, has nausea, reduced appetite and difficulty sleeping.

healthstate_name_pretty: End-stage renal disease, with kidney transplant
lay_description: sometimes feels tired and down, and has some difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: End-stage renal disease, on dialysis
lay_description: is tired and has itching, cramps, headache, joint pains and shortness of breath. The person needs intensive medical care every other day lasting about half a day.

healthstate_name_pretty: Decompensated cirrhosis of the liver
lay_description: has a swollen belly and swollen legs. The person feels weakness, fatigue and loss of appetite.

healthstate_name_pretty: Gastric bleeding
lay_description: vomits blood and feels nauseous.

healthstate_name_pretty: Crohn disease or ulcerative colitis
lay_description: has cramping abdominal pain, has diarrhea several times a day, and feels very tired for two months every year. When the person does not have symptoms, there is anxiety about them returning.

healthstate_name_pretty: Benign prostatic hypertrophy, symptomatic cases
lay_description: feels the urge to urinate frequently, but when passing urine it comes out slowly and sometimes is painful.

healthstate_name_pretty: Urinary incontinence
lay_description: cannot control urinating.

healthstate_name_pretty: Impotence
lay_description: has difficulty in obtaining or maintaining an erection.

healthstate_name_pretty: Infertility, primary
lay_description: wants to have a child and has a fertile partner, but the couple cannot conceive.

healthstate_name_pretty: Infertility, secondary
lay_description: has at least one child, and wants to have more children. The person has a fertile partner, but the couple cannot conceive.

healthstate_name_pretty: Asthma, controlled
lay_description: has wheezing and cough once a month, which does not cause difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Asthma, partially controlled
lay_description: has wheezing and cough once a week, which causes some difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Asthma, uncontrolled
lay_description: has wheezing, cough and shortness of breath more than twice a week, which causes difficulty with daily activities and sometimes wakes the person at night.

healthstate_name_pretty: COPD and other chronic respiratory problems, mild
lay_description: has cough and shortness of breath after heavy physical activity, but is able to walk long distances and climb stairs.

healthstate_name_pretty: COPD and other chronic respiratory problems, moderate
lay_description: has cough, wheezing and shortness of breath, even after light physical activity. The person feels tired and can walk only short distances or climb only a few stairs.

healthstate_name_pretty: COPD and other chronic respiratory problems, severe
lay_description: has cough, wheezing and shortness of breath all the time. The person has great difficulty walking even short distances or climbing any stairs, feels tired when at rest, and is anxious.

healthstate_name_pretty: Dementia, mild
lay_description: has some trouble remembering recent events, and finds it hard to concentrate and make decisions and plans.

healthstate_name_pretty: Dementia, moderate
lay_description: has memory problems and confusion, feels disoriented, at times hears voices that are not real, and needs help with some daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Dementia, severe
lay_description: has complete memory loss; no longer recognizes close family members; and requires help with all daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Headache, migraine
lay_description: has severe, throbbing head pain and nausea that cause great difficulty in daily activities and sometimes confine the person to bed. Moving around, light, and noise make it worse.

healthstate_name_pretty: Headache, tension-type
lay_description: has a moderate headache that also affects the neck, which causes difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Headache, medication overuse
lay_description: has daily headaches, felt as dull pain and often lasting all day, with poor sleep, nausea and fatigue. The person takes medicine for the headaches, which provides little relief but is needed to avoid having worse symptoms.

healthstate_name_pretty: Multiple sclerosis, mild
lay_description: has mild loss of feeling in one hand, is a little unsteady while walking, has slight loss of vision in one eye, and often needs to urinate urgently.

healthstate_name_pretty: Multiple sclerosis, moderate
lay_description: needs help walking, has difficulty with writing and arm coordination, has loss of vision in one eye and cannot control urinating.

healthstate_name_pretty: Multiple sclerosis, severe
lay_description: has slurred speech and difficulty swallowing. The person has weak arms and hands, very limited and stiff leg movement, has loss of vision in both eyes and cannot control urinating.

healthstate_name_pretty: Parkinson disease, mild
lay_description: has mild tremors and moves a little slowly, but is able to walk and do daily activities without assistance.

healthstate_name_pretty: Parkinson disease, moderate
lay_description: has moderate tremors and moves slowly, which causes some difficulty in walking and daily activities. The person has some trouble swallowing, talking, sleeping, and remembering things.

healthstate_name_pretty: Parkinson disease, severe
lay_description: has severe tremors and moves very slowly, which causes great difficulty in walking and daily activities. The person falls easily and has a lot of difficulty talking, swallowing, sleeping, and remembering things.

healthstate_name_pretty: Alcohol use disorder, mild
lay_description: drinks a lot of alcohol and sometimes has difficulty controlling the urge to drink. While intoxicated, the person has difficulty performing daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Alcohol use disorder, moderate
lay_description: drinks a lot, gets drunk almost every week and has great difficulty controlling the urge to drink. Drinking and recovering cause great difficulty in daily activities, sleep loss, and fatigue.

healthstate_name_pretty: Alcohol use disorder, severe
lay_description: gets drunk almost every day and is unable to control the urge to drink. Drinking and recovering replace most daily activities. The person has difficulty thinking, remembering and communicating, and feels constant pain and fatigue.

healthstate_name_pretty: Fetal alcohol syndrome, mild
lay_description: is a little slow in developing physically and mentally, which causes some difficulty in learning but no other difficulties in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Fetal alcohol syndrome, moderate
lay_description: is slow in developing physically and mentally, which causes some difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Fetal alcohol syndrome, severe
lay_description: is very slow in developing physically and mentally, which causes great difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Cannabis dependence
lay_description: uses marijuana daily and has difficulty controlling the habit. The person sometimes has mood swings, anxiety and hallucinations, and has some difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Amphetamine dependence
lay_description: uses stimulants (drugs) and has difficulty controlling the habit. The person sometimes has depression, hallucinations and mood swings, and has difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Cocaine dependence
lay_description: uses cocaine and has difficulty controlling the habit. The person sometimes has mood swings, anxiety, paranoia, hallucinations and sleep problems, and has some difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Heroin and other opioid dependence
lay_description: uses heroin daily and has difficulty controlling the habit. When the effects wear off, the person feels severe nausea, agitation, vomiting and fever. The person has a lot of difficulty in daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Anxiety disorders, mild
lay_description: feels mildly anxious and worried, which makes it slightly difficult to concentrate, remember things, and sleep. The person tires easily but is able to perform daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Anxiety disorders, moderate
lay_description: feels anxious and worried, which makes it difficult to concentrate, remember things, and sleep. The person tires easily and finds it difficult to perform daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Anxiety disorders, severe
lay_description: constantly feels very anxious and worried, which makes it difficult to concentrate, remember things and sleep. The person has lost pleasure in life and thinks about suicide.

healthstate_name_pretty: Major depressive disorder, mild episode
lay_description: feels persistent sadness and has lost interest in usual activities. The person sometimes sleeps badly, feels tired, or has trouble concentrating but still manages to function in daily life with extra effort.

healthstate_name_pretty: Major depressive disorder, moderate episode
lay_description: has constant sadness and has lost interest in usual activities. The person has some difficulty in daily life, sleeps badly, has trouble concentrating, and sometimes thinks about harming himself (or herself).

healthstate_name_pretty: Major depressive disorder, severe episode
lay_description: has overwhelming, constant sadness and cannot function in daily life. The person sometimes loses touch with reality and wants to harm or kill himself (or herself).

healthstate_name_pretty: Bipolar disorder, manic episode
lay_description: is hyperactive, hears and believes things that are not real, and engages in impulsive and aggressive behavior that endanger the person and others.

healthstate_name_pretty: Bipolar disorder, residual state
lay_description: has mild mood swings, irritability and some difficulty with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Schizophrenia, acute state
lay_description: hears and sees things that are not real and is afraid, confused, and sometimes violent. The person has great difficulty with communication and daily activities, and sometimes wants to harm or kill himself (or herself).

healthstate_name_pretty: Schizophrenia, residual state
lay_description: hears and sees things that are not real and has trouble communicating. The person can be forgetful, has difficulty with daily activities, and thinks about hurting himself (or herself).

healthstate_name_pretty: Anorexia nervosa
lay_description: feels an overwhelming need to starve and exercises excessively to lose weight. The person is very thin, weak and anxious.

healthstate_name_pretty: Bulimia nervosa
lay_description: has uncontrolled overeating followed by guilt, starving, and vomiting to lose weight.

healthstate_name_pretty: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
lay_description: is hyperactive and has difficulty concentrating, remembering things, and completing tasks.

healthstate_name_pretty: Conduct disorder
lay_description: has frequent behavior problems, which are sometimes violent. The person often has difficulty interacting with other people and feels irritable.

healthstate_name_pretty: Borderline intellectual functioning
lay_description: is slow in learning at school. As an adult, the person has some difficulty doing complex or unfamiliar tasks but otherwise functions independently.

healthstate_name_pretty: Intellectual disability / mental retardation, mild
lay_description: has low intelligence and is slow in learning at school. As an adult, the person can live independently, but often needs help to raise children and can only work at simple supervised jobs.

healthstate_name_pretty: Intellectual disability / mental retardation, moderate
lay_description: has low intelligence, and is slow in learning to speak and to do even simple tasks. As an adult, the person requires a lot of support to live independently and raise children. The person can only work at the simplest supervised jobs.

healthstate_name_pretty: Intellectual disability / mental retardation, severe
lay_description: has very low intelligence and cannot speak more than a few words, needs constant supervision and help with most daily activities, and can do only the simplest tasks.

healthstate_name_pretty: Intellectual disability / mental retardation, profound
lay_description: has very low intelligence, has almost no language, and does not understand even the most basic requests or instructions. The person requires constant supervision and help for all activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, mild
lay_description: has great difficulty hearing and understanding another person talking in a noisy place (for example, on an urban street).

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, moderate
lay_description: is unable to hear and understand another person talking in a noisy place (for example, on an urban street), and has difficulty hearing another person talking even in a quiet place or on the phone.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, severe
lay_description: is unable to hear and understand another person talking, even in a quiet place, and unable to take part in a phone conversation. Difficulties with communicating and relating to others cause emotional impact at times (for example worry or depression).

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, profound
lay_description: is unable to hear and understand another person talking, even in a quiet place, is unable to take part in a phone conversation, and has great difficulty hearing anything in any other situation. Difficulties with communicating and relating to othersoften cause worry, depression, and loneliness.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, complete
lay_description: cannot hear at all in any situation, including even the loudest sounds, and cannot communicate verbally or use a phone. Difficulties with communicating and relating to others often cause worry, depression or loneliness.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, mild, with ringing
lay_description: has great difficulty hearing and understanding another person talking in a noisy place (for example, on an urban street), and sometimes has annoying ringing in the ears.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, moderate, with ringing
lay_description: is unable to hear and understand another person talking in a noisy place (for example, on an urban street), and has difficulty hearing another person talking even in a quiet place or on the phone, and has annoying ringing in the ears for more than 5 minutes at a time, almost everyday.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, severe, with ringing
lay_description: is unable to hear and understand another person talking, even in a quiet place, and unable to take part in a phone conversation, and has annoying ringing in the ears for more than 5 minutes at a time, almost everyday. Difficulties with communicating and relating to others cause emotional impact at times (for example worry or depression).

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, profound, with ringing
lay_description: is unable to hear and understand another person talking, even in a quiet place, is unable to take part in a phone conversation, has great difficulty hearing anything in any other situation, and has annoying ringing in the ears for more than 5 minutes at a time, several times a day. Difficulties with communicating and relating to others often cause worry, depression, or loneliness.

healthstate_name_pretty: Hearing loss, complete, with ringing
lay_description: cannot hear at all in any situation, including even the loudest sounds, and cannot communicate verbally or use a phone, and has very annoying ringing in the ears for more than half of the day. Difficulties with communicating and relating to others often cause worry, depression or loneliness.

healthstate_name_pretty: Distance vision, mild impairment
lay_description: has some difficulty with distance vision, for example reading signs, but no other problems with eyesight.

healthstate_name_pretty: Distance vision, moderate impairment
lay_description: has vision problems that make it difficult to recognize faces or objects across a room.

healthstate_name_pretty: Distance vision, severe impairment
lay_description: has severe vision loss, which causes difficulty in daily activities, some emotional impact (for example worry), and some difficulty going outside the home without assistance.

healthstate_name_pretty: Distance vision blindness
lay_description: is completely blind, which causes great difficulty in some daily activities, worry and anxiety, and great difficulty going outside the home without assistance.

healthstate_name_pretty: Presbyopia
lay_description: has difficulty seeing things that are nearer than 3 feet, but has no difficulty with seeing things at a distance.

healthstate_name_pretty: Back pain, severe, without leg pain
lay_description: has severe back pain, which causes difficulty dressing, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting things. The person sleeps poorly and feels worried.

healthstate_name_pretty: Back pain, severe, with leg pain
lay_description: has severe back and leg pain, which causes difficulty dressing, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting things. The person sleeps poorly and feels worried.

healthstate_name_pretty: Back pain, most severe, without leg pain
lay_description: has constant back pain, which causes difficulty dressing, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting things. The person sleeps poorly, is worried, and has lost some enjoyment in life.

healthstate_name_pretty: Back pain, most severe, with leg pain
lay_description: has constant back and leg pain, which causes difficulty dressing, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting things. The person sleeps poorly, is worried, and has lost some enjoyment in life.

healthstate_name_pretty: Neck pain, mild
lay_description: has neck pain, and has difficulty turning the head and lifting things.

healthstate_name_pretty: Neck pain, severe
lay_description: has severe neck pain, and difficulty turning the head and lifting things. The person gets headaches and arm pain, sleeps poorly, and feels tired and worried.

healthstate_name_pretty: Neck pain, moderate
lay_description: has constant neck pain, and has difficulty turning the head, holding arms up, and lifting things

healthstate_name_pretty: Neck pain, most severe
lay_description: has constant neck pain and arm pain, and difficulty turning the head, holding arms up, and lifting things. The person gets headaches, sleeps poorly, and feels tired and worried.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, lower limbs, mild
lay_description: has pain in the leg, which causes some difficulty running, walking long distances, and getting up and down.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, lower limbs, moderate
lay_description: has moderate pain in the leg, which makes the person limp, and causes some difficulty walking, standing, lifting and carrying heavy things, getting up and down and sleeping.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, lower limbs, severe
lay_description: has severe pain in the leg, which makes the person limp and causes a lot of difficulty walking, standing, lifting and carrying heavy things, getting up and down, and sleeping.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, upper limbs, mild
lay_description: has mild pain and stiffness in the arms and hands. The person has some difficulty lifting, carrying and holding things.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, upper limbs, moderate
lay_description: has moderate pain and stiffness in the arms and hands, which causes difficulty lifting, carrying, and holding things, and trouble sleeping because of the pain.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, generalized, moderate
lay_description: has pain and deformity in most joints, causing difficulty moving around, getting up and down, and using the hands for lifting and carrying. The person often feels fatigue.

healthstate_name_pretty: Musculoskeletal problems, generalized, severe
lay_description: has severe, constant pain and deformity in most joints, causing difficulty moving around, getting up and down, eating, dressing, lifting, carrying and using the hands. The person often feels sadness, anxiety and extreme fatigue.

healthstate_name_pretty: Gout, acute
lay_description: has severe pain and swelling in the leg, making it very difficult to get up and down, stand, walk, lift, and carry heavy things. The person has trouble sleeping because of the pain.

healthstate_name_pretty: Spinal cord lesion below neck level (treated)
lay_description: is paralyzed from the waist down, cannot feel or move the legs and has difficulties with urine and bowel control. The person uses a wheelchair to move around.

healthstate_name_pretty: Abdominopelvic problem, mild
lay_description: has some pain in the belly that causes nausea but does not interfere with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Abdominopelvic problem, moderate
lay_description: has pain in the belly and feels nauseous. The person has difficulties with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Abdominopelvic problem, severe
lay_description: has severe pain in the belly and feels nauseous. The person is anxious and unable to carry out daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Anemia, mild
lay_description: feels slightly tired and weak at times, but this does not interfere with normal daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Anemia, moderate
lay_description: feels moderate fatigue, weakness, and shortness of breath after exercise, making daily activities more difficult.

healthstate_name_pretty: Anemia, severe
lay_description: feels very weak, tired and short of breath, and has problems with activities that require physical effort or deep concentration.

healthstate_name_pretty: Periodontitis
lay_description: has minor bleeding of the gums from time to time, with mild discomfort.

healthstate_name_pretty: Dental caries, symptomatic
lay_description: has a toothache, which causes some difficulty in eating.

healthstate_name_pretty: Severe tooth loss
lay_description: has lost more than 20 teeth including front and back, and has great difficulty in eating meat, fruits, and vegetables.

healthstate_name_pretty: Disfigurement, level 1

healthstate_name_pretty: Disfigurement, level 2

healthstate_name_pretty: Disfigurement, level 3
lay_description: has an obvious physical deformity that makes others uncomfortable, which causes the person to avoid social contact, feel worried, sleep poorly, and think about suicide.

healthstate_name_pretty: Disfigurement, level 1 with itch/pain
lay_description: has a slight, visible physical deformity that is sometimes sore or itchy. Others notice the deformity, which causes some worry and discomfort.

healthstate_name_pretty: Disfigurement, level 2, with itch/pain
lay_description: has a visible physical deformity that is sore and itchy. Other people stare and comment, which causes the person to worry. The person has trouble sleeping and concentrating.

healthstate_name_pretty: Disfigurement, level 3, with itch/pain
lay_description: has an obvious physical deformity that is very painful and itchy. The physical deformity makes others uncomfortable, which causes the person to avoid social contact, feel worried, sleep poorly, and think about suicide.

healthstate_name_pretty: Generic uncomplicated disease: worry and daily medication
lay_description: has a chronic disease that requires medication every day and causes some worry but minimal interference with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Generic uncomplicated disease: anxiety about diagnosis
lay_description: has a disease diagnosis that causes some worry but minimal interference with daily activities.

healthstate_name_pretty: Kwashiorkor
lay_description: is very tired and irritable and has diarrhea.

healthstate_name_pretty: Severe wasting
lay_description: is extremely skinny and has no energy.

healthstate_name_pretty: Speech problems
lay_description: has difficulty speaking, and others find it difficult to understand.

healthstate_name_pretty: Motor impairment, moderate

healthstate_name_pretty: Motor impairment, severe
lay_description: is unable to move around without help, and is not able to lift or hold objects, get dressed or sit upright.

lay_description: has some difficulty in moving around, holding objects, dressing and sitting upright, but can walk without help. The person has low intelligence and is slow in learning to speak and to do simple tasks.

healthstate_name_pretty: Motor plus cognitive impairments, severe
lay_description: cannot move around without help, and cannot lift or hold objects, get dressed or sit upright. The person also has very low intelligence, speaks few words, and needs constant supervision and help with all daily activities.
